A.explanation: The string particles do not move left to right with the wave. This is a transverse wave so each point moves up or down.

B.explanation: The particles do not oscillate left and right along the string. The wave energy moves left to right but the string moves at right angles to this.

C.explanation: Up, down, up is the opposite sense. It would be correct if the wave were travelling from right to left.

D.explanation: Shifting the whole shape slightly to the right makes points 1 and 3 move down and point 2 move up at this instant.

hints: Notice the wave travels from left to right but points 1, 2 and 3 are on different slopes - point 1 on the rising slope before the crest, point 2 on the falling slope after the crest, point 3 on the rising slope.
Remember this is a transverse wave on a string, so each particle moves up or down, not left or right with the wave.
Imagine the whole shape moved a small distance to the right and compare the new height at each fixed point with its old height to see if it must move up or down.
walkthrough: Identify the useful information: the wave profile moves left to right, point 1 is left of a crest with positive slope, point 2 is right of a crest with negative slope, point 3 is on a rising slope left of the next crest.
State the rule for a transverse travelling wave: particles vibrate at right angles to energy transfer, so points 1, 2 and 3 can only move up or down while the shape shifts sideways.

Use the small-shift method: in a short time $\Delta t$ the whole shape moves a small distance to the right, so the displacement at a fixed horizontal position becomes the old displacement from slightly to the left.
Apply this at point 1: the curve to its left is lower, so after the rightward shift a lower part of the curve arrives and point 1 must move down.
Apply this at point 2 and point 3: to the left of point 2 the curve is higher so point 2 must move up, while to the left of point 3 the curve is lower so point 3 must move down.
Combine the three results as down for point 1, up for point 2, down for point 3. This is option D.
